summary: This bill aims to improve federal wildfire management by increasing transparency in firefighting accounts, ensuring reimbursement for military-caused wildfires, enhancing strategic planning, studying local firefighter integration, deploying advanced detection and suppression technologies, and establishing new programs for post-fire recovery and invasive species reduction.

scores.thoughts: The bill authorizes appropriations for research and development of unmanned aircraft systems for wildfire response and establishes a new Long-Term Burned Area Rehabilitation account with an authorized appropriation of up to $100,000,000 annually. It also allows FEMA to provide funding for online guides for post-disaster assistance. These provisions directly lead to increased government spending.

The bill authorizes new appropriations and spending programs for wildfire preparation, detection, suppression, and post-fire recovery (including up to $100 million annually for a new rehabilitation account and 'such sums as necessary' for several studies and initiatives) without any offsetting revenue or cuts, thereby directing federal resources toward these priorities.
